question: A corporation makes a rights offering to raise $10 million of new capital by issuing one million shares of common stock. If it already has six million shares outstanding at the time of the offering. What is the subscription price per share? A. $4 B. $6 C. $7 D. $10

What subscription ratio is the corporation establishing for each new share? A. 6 rights per share B. 10 rights per share C. 6 million rights per share D. 10 million rights per share
